title: PlantSeg3D: Gaussian Plant Instance Segmentation with Geometry-aware Refinement
abstract: This paper proposes an annotation-free framework for 3D plant instance segmentation. Existing methods either struggle with overlapping leaves or require costly 3D annotations. Our approach lifts pretrained SAM 3 masks into a 3D Gaussian Splatting representation through occlusion-aware multi-view voting and refines them with semantic and geometric priors to recover coherent leaf instances. Experiments demonstrate robust segmentation of touching, folded, and occluded leaves without 3D supervision, providing a practical foundation for semantic 3D plant phenotyping.
